responsibility: Defines unit-style tests and MIR/coverage-graph test scaffolding for the coverage instrumentation module, constructing mock MIR bodies and asserting the coverage graph and related coverage-specific transformations behave as expected on representative control-flow patterns.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `coverage/counters/tests.rs`, this `tests.rs` covers the top-level coverage instrumentation machinery: it defines MIR-building test scaffolding, constructs mock `Body` control-flow shapes, and asserts `CoverageGraph` behavior. Its focus is integration-style testing of coverage CFG/BCB logic rather than the counters submodule’s standalone cancellation routine.
